annotations.description: With only 1 land in hand, the player bottomed Battleground Geist (5 mana, requires U) instead of Bone Pit Brute (6 mana, requires RR). Bone Pit Brute is harder to cast and more expensive, making it arguably the worse card to keep in a land-light hand.
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Bone Pit Brute, which costs 6 mana with double red requirement and is the hardest card in hand to cast. With only 1 land, keeping cheaper options maximizes the chance of curving out.

annotations.description: Gem31P Teach timed out on the Thriving Moor color choice. The default selection was likely White (or another non-Red color), which is useless for their Black/Red/Green deck. They already have two Forests for green and a Swamp for black, so Red was clearly the correct choice to access their third color (Flametongue Kavu, Bone Pit Brute, Goblin Warchief, Temur Battle Rage in deck).
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out, resulting in a default color choice (likely not Red).
annotations.betterLine: Choose Red for Thriving Moor, since they have no red sources in hand and multiple powerful red cards in their deck.

annotations.description: Opponent's only creature is Murmuring Phantasm (0/5 defender) which can block but deals 0 damage. Attacking with both Durable Coilbug (2/2) and Trufflesnout (3/3) is completely risk-free: the Phantasm can only block one, the other gets through for 2-3 damage, and the blocked creature survives since Phantasm has 0 power. Missing free damage with no downside.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to attack with either creature.
annotations.betterLine: Attack with both Durable Coilbug and Trufflesnout. At least 2-3 damage gets through for free. Could also cast Irresistible Prey on one attacker to force the block and draw a card, guaranteeing the other gets through.

annotations.description: Passed priority in postcombat main phase with exactly enough mana (4 untapped lands) to cast Bone Picker, a 3/2 flying deathtouch creature. This wastes an entire turn of mana development and misses deploying an evasive threat that flies over the opponent's Murmuring Phantasm defender.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, ending the turn with 4 untapped mana and a castable Bone Picker in hand.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Bone Picker for {3}{B} using the 4 untapped lands. A 3/2 flying deathtouch is an excellent threat that flies over the opponent's 0/5 Phantasm and pressures their 18 life total.

annotations.description: Passed on casting Irresistible Prey when it could target Bone Picker (flying, deathtouch) to force Murmuring Phantasm to block next combat, killing the 0/5 defender via deathtouch while Bone Picker survives. At worst, Irresistible Prey cantrips for G.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Irresistible Prey
annotations.betterLine: Cast Irresistible Prey targeting Bone Picker to draw a card and set up a favorable forced block next turn that removes Murmuring Phantasm via deathtouch

annotations.description: Gem31P Teach declined to activate Durable Coilbug's graveyard ability with 6 untapped lands and an empty board. With Goblin Warchief (hasty 2/2) about to resolve alongside the existing Flametongue Kavu 4/2, they're facing 6 damage with no blockers. Returning Coilbug to hand (5 mana) and casting Liliana's Steward (1 mana) this turn would provide an immediate blocker.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed on activating Durable Coilbug's return-to-hand ability
annotations.betterLine: Activate Durable Coilbug (4B) to return it to hand, then cast Liliana's Steward (B) with remaining mana to get a 1/2 blocker on board immediately, with Coilbug available to cast next turn.

annotations.description: At 4 life facing 6 power of attackers (Flametongue Kavu 4/2 + Goblin Warchief 2/2) that will be lethal next turn, the player passed their entire main phase without playing any cards. They had a land drop available (Swamp) and could cast both Durable Coilbug (2/2) and Liliana's Steward (1/2) as blockers to survive the next attack.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main phase, deploying no blockers and missing a land drop while facing lethal on board.
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp, then cast Durable Coilbug (1B) and Liliana's Steward (B) to have two blockers. These can block the 4/2 Flametongue Kavu and 2/2 Goblin Warchief respectively, preventing lethal damage next turn.

annotations.description: Cast Liliana's Steward before playing the Swamp from hand. At 4 life in a desperate situation, playing the land first is strictly better sequencing - it maximizes available mana and flexibility before committing to spells. While the extra mana doesn't change what can be cast this specific turn, it's free value that could matter if the opponent responds with something at instant speed.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Liliana's Steward without first playing the Swamp from hand
annotations.betterLine: Play Swamp first, then cast Liliana's Steward, preserving maximum mana flexibility

annotations.description: With the opponent at 4 life and two attackers in combat (Flametongue Kavu 4/2 and Goblin Warchief 2/2), casting Capture Sphere on Durable Coilbug before blocks would tap it and remove it as a blocker. The opponent would only have Liliana's Steward 1/2 to block one attacker, letting the other through. If they block the Kavu, the Warchief deals 2 (opponent to 2 with no board). If they block the Warchief, the Kavu deals 4 for lethal. Either way, this significantly improves the attack outcome.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Capture Sphere, allowing both opponent creatures to potentially block.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Capture Sphere targeting Durable Coilbug before blocks. The opponent is forced to choose which attacker to block with their remaining 1/2, and blocking the Warchief means lethal from the Kavu. The opponent survives at 2 but with no creatures — virtually game-winning.
